title: Lonna O NDE 3162
content: I was told (after the fact) that I was given a cocktail of heavy duty drugs. I didn't remember having been given the drugs. I must have had a violent reaction to them immediately. My baby had not been delivered yet. I remember being up high in a corner of the hospital room, watching all of those people serving me being in a panic state. I saw myself lying on the bed, but, although I knew it was I, I wasn't the least bit concerned about it. It was in no way a part of me anymore. I kept saying, 'Please don't worry about me. I'm fine.' I realized that they couldn't hear me. I felt so bad that they were in a turmoil when I was feeling fine. I felt free of all care, and yet I didn't feel dead although I didn't feel separated from where I would have preferred being. Two days later, I awoke inside an oxygen tent. Just before I woke up, I was having a satellite kind of dream, with rockets, stars, everything ethereal flying around me. I felt 'wow' - not afraid but overwhelmed by all of the confusion. It wasn't a pleasant dream and not a place I wanted to be. I was told at that time that my baby had been delivered and that I had had a girl. I wasn't aware of anything connected to the delivery. Later, when I was telling my experience to my registered nurse friend who was with me at the hospital, I told her if I were an artist, I could have drawn the exact scene I was witnessing from above - even to the people there, whom I had never seen before or since. I saw everyone flying around my hospital bed and heard everything that was being said. I remember glancing at my body on the bed. I think I realized it was a dead body, but it didn't seen relevant to me.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Reaction to a 'cocktail of heavy duty drugs' given before delivery; later awoke in an oxygen tent.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Later described a 'satellite kind of dream, with rockets, stars, everything ethereal flying around me' just before waking.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE in hospital room; later (two days later, just before waking) a distressing space/rocket-themed dream is mentioned.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Just before waking two days later, reported a 'satellite kind of dream, with rockets, stars, everything ethereal flying around me' that felt confusing and not pleasant.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Please don't worry about me. I'm fine.”; “I could have drawn the exact scene I was witnessing from above.”
